page_title: UNI 0-1 HOL | Union Berlin v Holstein Kiel 02/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Tobias Reichel is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+4' The corner kick from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90+3' A quickly taken corner by Holstein Kiel.
90+2' Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
90+2' Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+1' The resulting corner from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is cleared by the defence.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Union Berlin get a corner.
87' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly over the crossbar.
83' Marcel Rapp decides to make a substitution. David Zec will be replaced by Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel) comes onto the pitch for Max Geschwill.
77' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
76' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
75' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) replaces Lucas Tousart.
75' Substitution. Benedict Hollerbach did his best and is replaced by Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
74' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is adjudged offside.
73' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) unleashes a tremendous shot from distance, but it crashes against the right post! If it had flown more to the left it would have been a cracker!
72' Marko Ivezic (Holstein Kiel) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post.
72' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Holstein Kiel.
71' Here is a change. Phil Harres is going off and Marcel Rapp gives the last tactical orders to Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel).
70' That's the end of the game for Timo Becker, who is replaced by Marko Ivezic (Holstein Kiel).
69' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Timon Weiner intercepts the ball.
68' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) takes the corner but it's cleared.
66' Frederik Ronnow displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) replaces Woo-Yeong Jeong.
65' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) replacing Tom Rothe.
65' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tobias Reichel no option but to blow his whistle.
61' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
59' The manager makes a subsitution with Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) coming on for Armin Gigovic.
58' Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel) latches onto a short pass from Shuto Machino inside the box, but clips his shot high over the bar.

57' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the right post.
57' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
54' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Frederik Ronnow makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
48' The corner from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is cleared away by the defence.
47' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

46' The ball squirts out to Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) inside the box, and his first-time drive beats the keeper but fails to find the net as it's amazingly blocked on the line by a defender. Now Union Berlin have a corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Marin Ljubicic (Union Berlin) will not participate anymore and Andrej Ilic is coming on.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Tobias Reichel has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Marin Ljubicic (Union Berlin) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Reichel had an easy-decision to make.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
44' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
42' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.

42' 0 - 1 Goal! Shuto Machino slips a clever pass through to Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
41' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) takes the corner which is cleared.

40' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Holstein Kiel are awarded a corner kick.
40' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) was quite harsh and Tobias Reichel didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
38' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
36' A pass from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is intercepted by Timon Weiner and the move breaks down.
35' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) takes it short.

35' A lofted cross from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The linesman makes the right call and Union Berlin will have a corner.
33' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

33' Marin Ljubicic (Union Berlin) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball has crossed the sideline. Union Berlin are taking a throw-in.
30' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
26' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) sends a long ball in, but Timon Weiner comfortably gathers the ball.
25' Ball possession – 44:56.
24' A cross into the box from Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) is cleared.
22' Tobias Reichel has a clear sight and sees a foul from Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel).
20' Wow, what an escape. Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
15' Marco Komenda (Holstein Kiel) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
15' Referee Tobias Reichel sees the trip by Marin Ljubicic (Union Berlin) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Holstein Kiel are awarded the free kick.
14' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar.
14' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
13' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball is out of play. Union Berlin win a corner kick.
12' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Timon Weiner.
11' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) takes the corner.
11' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Union Berlin force a corner. They send men into the box.
9' The ball is crossed into the box and Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Timon Weiner gets a glove on it to thwart him.
9' A cross from Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
8' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
6' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Union Berlin.
5' Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Frederik Ronnow.
3' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
3' Timon Weiner leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin).
2' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Union Berlin will take a corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Holstein Kiel will have the kick-off.
Tobias Reichel is the one to supervise the game today.
